description: This file defines the NoteResponse data transfer object (DTO) class for the notes backend API, representing the response data structure for notes.

classes.name: NoteResponse
classes.description: A DTO for transferring note response data, including id, title, content, tags, archived status, and timestamps.

methods.name: getId()
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the note.

methods.name: setId(Long id)
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the note.

methods.name: getTitle()
methods.description: Returns the title of the note.

methods.name: setTitle(String title)
methods.description: Sets the title of the note.

methods.name: getContent()
methods.description: Returns the content/body of the note.

methods.name: setContent(String content)
methods.description: Sets the content/body of the note.

methods.name: getTags()
methods.description: Returns the tags associated with the note.

methods.name: setTags(String tags)
methods.description: Sets the tags for the note.

methods.name: isArchived()
methods.description: Returns whether the note is archived.

methods.name: setArchived(boolean archived)
methods.description: Sets the archived status of the note.
